# danish: Jeg bor i en lille lejlighed i Aarhus.
english: I live in a small flat in Aarhus.

# danish: Vores hus har tre soveværelser og et badeværelse.
english: Our house has three bedrooms and one bathroom.

# danish: Køkkenet er lille, men der er plads til et bord.
english: The kitchen is small, but there is room for a table.

# danish: Kan du lukke vinduet? Det trækker.
english: Can you close the window? There is a draught.

# danish: Jeg har lagt nøglen på bordet i entréen.
english: I have put the key on the table in the entrance hall.

# danish: Vi flytter ind i den nye lejlighed på fredag.
english: We are moving into the new flat on Friday.

# danish: Hvor meget betaler du i husleje om måneden?
english: How much do you pay in rent each month?

# danish: Vaskemaskinen står i bryggerset.
english: The washing machine is in the utility room.

# danish: Jeg skal vaske tøj og gøre rent i dag.
english: I need to do laundry and clean today.

# danish: Vil du tage opvasken, mens jeg tørrer bordet af?
english: Will you do the dishes while I wipe the table?

# danish: Der er ikke flere rene håndklæder i skabet.
english: There are no more clean towels in the cupboard.

# danish: Lampen ved siden af sofaen er tændt.
english: The lamp beside the sofa is on.

# danish: Husk at slukke lyset, når du går.
english: Remember to turn off the light when you leave.

# danish: Jeg kan høre naboen gennem væggen.
english: I can hear the neighbour through the wall.

# danish: Vi har en altan med udsigt over gården.
english: We have a balcony overlooking the courtyard.

# danish: Radiatoren bliver ikke varm.
english: The radiator is not getting warm.

# danish: Vandhanen drypper, så jeg ringer til viceværten.
english: The tap is dripping, so I am calling the caretaker.

# danish: Papir og glas skal i hver sin beholder.
english: Paper and glass go in separate containers.

# danish: Har du husket at låse hoveddøren?
english: Have you remembered to lock the front door?

# danish: Det er dejligt at være hjemme igen.
english: It is lovely to be home again.
